# discord_guild_scheduled_event (Resource)

Manages a Discord guild scheduled event. Requires `MANAGE_EVENTS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_guild_scheduled_event" "launch" {
  guild_id             = "123456789012345678"
  name                 = "Product Launch"
  description          = "Join us for the big reveal"
  entity_type          = 3 # EXTERNAL
  privacy_level        = 2 # GUILD_ONLY
  scheduled_start_time = "2026-07-01T17:00:00Z"
  scheduled_end_time   = "2026-07-01T18:00:00Z"
  location             = "https://example.com/live"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entity_type` (Number) Entity type: 1 STAGE_INSTANCE, 2 VOICE, 3 EXTERNAL.
- `guild_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild. Changing this forces a new event.
- `name` (String) Event name (1-100 characters).
- `scheduled_start_time` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp for when the event starts.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) Stage or voice channel ID. Required for STAGE_INSTANCE and VOICE events; must be omitted for EXTERNAL.
- `description` (String) Event description (1-1000 characters).
- `image` (String) Cover image as a data URI. Write-only; Discord does not return it on read.
- `location` (String) Location of an EXTERNAL event (entity_metadata.location). Required for EXTERNAL events.
- `privacy_level` (Number) Privacy level: 2 GUILD_ONLY (the only supported value).
- `scheduled_end_time` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp for when the event ends. Required for EXTERNAL events.
- `status` (Number) Event status: 1 SCHEDULED, 2 ACTIVE, 3 COMPLETED, 4 CANCELED.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Scheduled events are imported using "guild_id:event_id".
terraform import discord_guild_scheduled_event.launch 123456789012345678:555555555555555555
```
